declaration.preface: I acknowledge that I have received, read, and understood the Living Wage Policy of Ami Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd.
declaration.declaration:
I recognize the importance of fair and adequate compensation and commit to:

Understanding the principles outlined in the policy and how they relate to wage standards.

Supporting the company’s commitment to paying wages that meet basic living needs and ensure a decent standard of living.

Ensuring transparency and fairness in wage-related matters within my role.

Complying with all relevant laws, regulations, and company guidelines regarding wages and remuneration.

Reporting any concerns or discrepancies related to wage payments or living wage compliance immediately.
